item.title: Almond Crescents
item.description:
This makes about one baking tray.

Ingredients

  • 200g marzipan paste
  • 100g sliced almonds
  • 100g dark cake glaze
  • 1 egg white
  • 100g sugar

Instructions

  1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (convection 180°C).
  2. Mix the marzipan thoroughly with sugar and egg white. Shape the mixture into a roll with wet hands and divide into equal-sized pieces. Shape these into small crescents and roll in sliced almonds.
  3. Place the crescents on baking paper, press down slightly and bake until golden brown for about 15 minutes (no longer, they continue baking!).
  4. Finally, dip the ends of the cooled crescents in warmed cake glaze.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Annik's Pasta Casserole
item.description:
This makes enough for a medium to large casserole dish.

Ingredients

  • 300g pasta
  • 200g grated cheese
  • 150g cooked ham
  • 3 eggs
  • 40g crème fraîche
  • Salt
  • Nutmeg
  • Parmesan

Instructions

  1. Cook the pasta and cut the ham into small rectangles.
  2. Layer the pasta alternately with the ham and cheese in a casserole dish.
  3. Mix the eggs with the crème fraîche, a pinch of salt and nutmeg, then pour over the pasta.
  4. Sprinkle the Parmesan on top and bake at 200°C for about 15-20 minutes.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Baguette
item.description:
Ingredients
2

  • 300ml lukewarm water
  • 15g fresh yeast
  • 5g sugar
  • 380g wheat flour (type 550)
  • 7g salt
  • 125g crispy fried onions (optional)

Instructions

  1. Add water, yeast and sugar to a bowl and mix well.
  2. Add flour, salt and fried onions and knead into a smooth dough.
  3. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rise for 2 hours.
  4. Divide the dough into two equal pieces, shape into baguettes and place on a baguette tray with baking paper.
  5. Dust the baguettes with flour and bake for about 25 minutes at 240°C with top and bottom heat.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Ben's Chicken Teriyaki
item.description:
Ingredients for the Sauce
4

  • 3 tbsp soy sauce
  • 3 tbsp brown sugar
  • 1 tsp apple cider vinegar
  • 1 tbsp sesame oil
  • 1 tsp grated ginger
  • 1 tsp grated garlic

Other Ingredients

  • 450g chicken breast fillet
  • 1/4 tsp salt
  • 1/4 tsp pepper
  • 1.5 tbsp oil
  • 1 tsp sesame seeds
  • One spring onion

Instructions

  1. Grate ginger and garlic and mix with the other sauce ingredients in a bowl.
  2. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
  3. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the chicken. Season with salt and pepper.
  4. Fry the meat on high heat for 5-6 minutes until the water has completely evaporated and it’s nicely browned.
  5. Add the teriyaki sauce and let it simmer for 3-4 minutes on medium heat until the sauce has thickened.
  6. Garnish with sesame seeds and chopped spring onions.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Birger's Potato Soup
item.description:
Ingredients
6

  • 125g coarse ham cubes
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • One onion
  • 2 tbsp wheat flour
  • 1L chicken broth
  • 240ml whole milk
  • One container heavy cream
  • 4-5 potatoes (floury)
  • 125g cheddar cheese
  • Paprika seasoning
  • Salt
  • Pepper

Instructions

  1. Fry the ham cubes in butter in a large pot.
  2. Finely chop the onion, add to the ham cubes and fry briefly.
  3. Add the flour, stir well, then stir in the whole milk, heavy cream, and chicken broth.
  4. Cut the potatoes into cubes and add them as well.
  5. Let the soup simmer until the potatoes are soft (at least 20 minutes).
  6. Finally, add 100g of the cheddar and season with salt, pepper and paprika.
  7. Serve with spring onions, the remaining cheddar and sour cream as desired.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Bread Patties
item.description:
A recipe for using up old bread leftovers. If possible, slice bread and rolls thinly before drying.

Ingredients

  • 325g dried bread/rolls
  • 4 onions
  • 1L milk
  • 4 eggs
  • 5 heaped tbsp wheat flour
  • 125g ham cubes
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Frying oil
  • Applesauce

Instructions

  1. Heat the milk in a large pot and soak the bread and roll slices in it. Depending on the type of bread, a little more or less milk may be needed. If the bread is very hard, it may take a while to fully soak.
  2. Once the bread is soft, blend the mixture with a hand blender.
  3. Peel the onions, cut into small cubes and add to the bread mixture.
  4. Add the eggs, flour and ham cubes and mix everything well.
  5. Season with salt and pepper.
  6. Heat some oil in a pan and fry the patties in batches. If the mixture is too runny, add a little more flour.

The patties taste best with applesauce and can also be frozen.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Cheese Fondue
item.description:
Ingredients
5

  • 300ml dry white wine
  • 300g Emmental cheese
  • 300g Gruyère cheese
  • 3 cloves of garlic
  • 5cl kirsch (cherry brandy)
  • About 2 tbsp cornstarch
  • 3-4 large baguettes

Instructions

  1. Grate the Emmental and Gruyère.
  2. Rub the fondue pot with a clove of garlic.
  3. Pour the wine into the pot and heat.
  4. While stirring constantly, gradually add the cheese and let it melt.
  5. Press the remaining two cloves of garlic and add to the cheese.
  6. Dissolve the cornstarch in kirsch and stir into the fondue. The fondue should now have a creamy consistency. Add a little more starch if needed.
  7. Cut the baguette into finger-width slices and serve with the fondue.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Chicken Stifado
item.description:
Ingredients
5

  • 400g onions
  • 700g chicken breast fillet
  • Dried rosemary
  • 1-2 tbsp oil
  • 1 tbsp tomato paste
  • 1L crushed tomatoes
  • 250ml vegetable broth
  • Salt and pepper
  • Rice
  • 2 cloves of garlic (optional)

Instructions

  1. Cut the meat into bite-sized cubes and brown with the oil in a Dutch oven with the lid on.
  2. Cut the onions into coarse cubes, the garlic into fine cubes, and add to the meat.
  3. Add the tomato paste and fry briefly.
  4. Add the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and season with salt, pepper and rosemary.
  5. Let the stifado simmer for 15 to 20 minutes on medium heat.
  6. Meanwhile, cook the rice.
  7. Serve the stifado with the rice.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Crêpes
item.description:
Ingredients
3

  • 4 eggs
  • 500ml milk
  • 1 pinch of salt
  • 2 tbsp oil
  • 250g flour
    • Either 250g wheat flour (type 405),
    • 250g spelt flour (type 630),
    • or 200g of one of the above flours and 50g whole wheat flour
  • Butter

Instructions

  1. Whisk the first four ingredients together well in a bowl.
  2. Stir in the flour.
  3. Fry the crêpes with butter in a pan.

Enjoy your meal!

PS: The pan is still hot… cut an apple into small wedges and toss with vanilla sugar (and cinnamon) in butter.

item.title: Eva's Potato Cheese Spread
item.description:
Ingredients
4

  • 4 floury potatoes
  • 1-2 splashes of cream
  • 1 container sour cream
  • 1 onion
  • 1 bunch of chives
  • Salt
  • Pepper

Instructions

  1. Cook the potatoes for 20 minutes, then peel and coarsely grate.
  2. Mix the sour cream and cream into the potatoes and season with salt and pepper. Finely chop the onion and fold in as well.
  3. Garnish the potato cheese spread with finely chopped chives.

Enjoy your meal!

PS: Erdapfelkäs is a Bavarian specialty and is usually eaten as a bread spread.

item.title: Feta Cheese Spread
item.description:
Feta cheese spread for baguette or as a dip for grilling.

Ingredients

  • 100g feta cheese
  • 200g cream cheese
  • 100g sour cream
  • 2 tbsp ajvar
  • One clove of garlic
  • 1 tbsp chopped parsley

Instructions

  1. Peel and finely chop the garlic clove.
  2. Mix feta cheese, cream cheese, sour cream and garlic.
  3. Stir in parsley and ajvar.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Gently Braised Pork Medallions with Potato Gratin
item.description:
This makes enough for a medium to large casserole dish.

Ingredients for the Medallions

  • 700g pork tenderloin
  • 40ml water
  • 300ml cooking cream
  • Tarragon
  • Salt
  • Pepper

Ingredients for the Gratin

  • 1200g waxy potatoes
  • 1 clove of garlic
  • 200ml cream
  • 550ml fresh whole milk
  • 1 1/2 tbsp vegetable broth
  • Butter
  • Nutmeg
  • Salt
  • Pepper

Preparing the Medallions

  1. Sear the whole pork tenderloin on all sides in a little oil (high-heat suitable) in a stainless steel pan.
  2. Place the pork tenderloin on a serving platter and gently cook in the oven at 100°C with top and bottom heat for about 50 minutes.
  3. Add the water to the hot pan and loosen the browned bits with a cooking spoon.
  4. Add the cooking cream and season to taste with tarragon, salt and pepper.
  5. Remove the pork tenderloin from the oven and cut into medallions about 4cm thick.
  6. Pour the sauce into a gravy boat and serve with the medallions.

Preparing the Gratin

  1. Grease the casserole dish with butter.
  2. Peel the garlic and distribute finely chopped evenly in the casserole dish.
  3. Peel the potatoes and slice thinly with a vegetable slicer.
  4. Layer the potatoes in the dish and season with salt and nutmeg after each layer.
  5. Mix the cream and milk into a sauce and season with vegetable broth, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
  6. Pour the sauce evenly over the layered potatoes. The potatoes should be completely covered by the sauce; add more milk if needed.
  7. Bake the gratin at 180°C for about one hour. Baking time may vary depending on the thickness of the potato slices (test with a fork).

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Italian Pasta Salad
item.description:
Makes a medium-sized bowl.

Ingredients

  • 250g farfalle
  • 100g sun-dried tomatoes in oil, cut into strips
  • 100g arugula
  • 50g pine nuts
  • 1 tbsp oregano
  • 50ml olive oil
  • 1 clove of garlic
  • 3 spring onions
  • 1/2 tsp chili
  • 2 knife tips of pepper

Instructions

  1. Cook pasta al dente, drain, rinse with cold water and stir in 1 tbsp olive oil.
  2. Toast the pine nuts in a pan on low to medium heat until golden brown.
  3. Cut the spring onions into thin slices and add to the pasta along with the tomato strips, arugula, pine nuts and oregano.
  4. For the dressing, mix olive oil, pressed garlic, chili and pepper and fold into the salad.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Lasagne
item.description:
This makes enough for a medium to large casserole dish.

Ingredients for the Tomato Sauce

  • 1 large onion
  • 2 cloves of garlic
  • Olive oil
  • 600g ground meat
  • 200ml white wine
  • 2 tbsp tomato paste
  • 500ml vegetable broth
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Sugar

Ingredients for the Béchamel Sauce

  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 3 level tbsp wheat flour
  • 500ml milk
  • Salt
  • Nutmeg

Other Ingredients

  • Butter
  • Lasagne sheets
  • Grated mozzarella
  • Optional: Parmesan

Preparing the Tomato Sauce

Cut the onions and garlic into small cubes and fry in oil in a (large!) pan on low to medium heat until golden brown. Add the ground meat, fry through and then deglaze with the wine. Once the wine has almost completely reduced, add the tomato paste and let it cook briefly. Add the water and broth and let the sauce cook for a few minutes with a lid on. Season with pepper, salt and a pinch of sugar.

Preparing the Béchamel Sauce

Melt the butter in a (small) pot and stir in the flour. While stirring, gradually add the milk. Season with salt and nutmeg and bring to a boil while stirring constantly.

Preparing the Lasagne

Grease the casserole dish with butter. Then layer the lasagne repeatedly with lasagne sheets - béchamel sauce - tomato sauce - cheese. The top layer can end with either Parmesan or mozzarella. When layering, make sure the lasagne sheets are sufficiently covered with liquid to cook in the oven. Bake the lasagne in a preheated oven at about 180°C for about 20 minutes. Test with a fork before removing from the oven to check if the lasagne sheets are cooked through.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Lena's Schupfnudel Pan
item.description:
This makes a large pan.

Ingredients

  • 500g Schupfnudeln (German potato noodles)
  • 2 onions
  • 650g sauerkraut
  • 100-150g ham cubes
  • 1 apple (sweet and fruity)

Instructions

  1. Fry the ham cubes in a large pan on medium heat.
  2. Peel the onions, cut into cubes and add to the ham cubes.
  3. Add the Schupfnudeln and fry.
  4. Drain the sauerkraut and fold into the Schupfnudeln.
  5. Peel and core the apple, cut into cubes and fold into the Schupfnudeln.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Mum's Cheesecake
item.description:
Makes enough for a 28cm springform pan.

Ingredients

  • 150g wheat flour
  • 240g sugar
  • 2 packets vanilla sugar
  • 100g vegetable margarine (e.g. Deli)
  • 250g soft butter
  • 7 eggs
  • One organic lemon
  • 1kg low-fat quark
  • Salt

Instructions

  1. Process the flour, 40g sugar, one packet of vanilla sugar and the vegetable margarine with a mixer into a dough.
  2. Line the bottom of the springform pan with baking paper, roll out the dough on it, then attach the rim of the springform pan.
  3. Separate the eggs into yolks and whites.
  4. Zest the lemon and squeeze out the juice.
  5. Mix the butter, 200g sugar, one packet of vanilla sugar, 7 egg yolks, the lemon zest, a pinch of salt, three tablespoons of lemon juice and the quark.
  6. Beat the 7 egg whites to stiff peaks and fold into the butter-sugar mixture.
  7. Pour the mixture onto the dough base and smooth out.
  8. Bake the cake at 150°C convection for 70-80 minutes on a rack in the springform pan.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: New Year's Eve Salad
item.description:
This makes a medium to large bowl.

Ingredients for the Salad

  • 200g lamb’s lettuce
  • One pomegranate
  • 200g walnuts
  • 125g shaved Parmesan
  • A handful of arugula

Ingredients for the Dressing

  • 4 tbsp sweet fruit vinegar (e.g. raspberry vinegar)
  • 8 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tbsp medium-hot mustard
  • Some salt and pepper

Instructions

  1. Wash the lamb’s lettuce and spin dry.
  2. Halve the pomegranate and remove the seeds.
  3. Add the lamb’s lettuce, pomegranate seeds, walnuts, Parmesan and arugula to a bowl.
  4. For the dressing, add all ingredients to a small bowl and mix well.
  5. Fold the dressing evenly into the salad.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Pesto alla Genovese
item.description:
This makes about one jar.

Ingredients

  • 100g basil (leaves only, no stems) (25g equals about one pot)
  • 100g Parmesan (freshly grated)
  • 80g pine nuts
  • 4 cloves of garlic
  • 1 tsp coarse sea salt
  • 240ml extra virgin olive oil

Instructions

  1. Toast the pine nuts in a pan on low to medium heat until lightly browned.
  2. Add basil, salt, garlic and toasted pine nuts to a measuring cup, fill with olive oil and blend with an immersion blender.
  3. Add the Parmesan.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Pizza
item.description:
Ingredients for the Dough
5

  • 800g flour
  • 2 packets (14g) dry yeast (1 packet of yeast for flour amounts < 500g)
  • 2 tsp salt
  • 2 tsp sugar
  • 400ml lukewarm water (2 parts flour, 1 part water)
  • 24ml olive oil (3ml per 100g flour)

Ingredients for the Tomato Sauce

  • 2 cloves of garlic
  • A bunch of fresh basil
  • Olive oil
  • 400g canned tomatoes
  • 400g crushed tomatoes
  • Salt
  • Pepper

Ingredients for the Topping

  • Mozzarella (Buffalo Mozzarella) 5 packages
  • Creativity

Preparing the Dough

Stir the sugar and yeast into the lukewarm water. Give the water-yeast mixture some time and then add the olive oil. Take a sufficiently large bowl and combine the flour, salt and water mixture (kneading hooks and mixer). Then knead the dough by hand for another 10 minutes. The dough must now rest for 45 minutes. Cover the bowl with a damp kitchen towel and place in a warm spot.

Preparing the Sauce

Peel the garlic cloves and chop them into fine cubes. Pluck the basil leaves from the stems and chop finely. Heat a small pot on low to medium heat and sauté the garlic in a little olive oil until golden brown. Add the chopped basil as well as the chopped and crushed tomatoes and season the sauce with salt and pepper. Let the sauce simmer for about 20 minutes on low to medium heat and crush the tomatoes with a cooking spoon. Taste and season more if needed.

Preparing the Pizza

If you like, you can freeze some of the dough. Shape the rest of the dough into evenly sized balls. If you don’t freeze any dough, you should get about 5-6 balls. To roll out a pizza, press a dough ball flat and roll it out thin with a rolling pin. Spread the sauce on the dough and top the pizza with your favorite toppings.

Baking the Pizza

Bake the pizza at 250°C

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Red Lentil Lasagne
item.description:
This makes enough for a medium to large casserole dish.

Ingredients for the Tomato Sauce

  • 125g red lentils
  • 1 large onion
  • 2 cloves of garlic
  • 3 carrots
  • 1 tbsp tomato paste
  • 500ml crushed tomatoes
  • 300ml vegetable broth
  • Salt
  • Pepper

Ingredients for the Béchamel Sauce

  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 3 level tbsp wheat flour
  • 500ml milk
  • Salt
  • Nutmeg

Other Ingredients

  • Butter
  • Lasagne sheets
  • Grated mozzarella
  • Optional: Parmesan

Preparing the Tomato Sauce

Cut onions, garlic and carrots into small cubes and fry in oil in a (large!) pan on low to medium heat until golden brown. Then add the tomato paste and let it cook briefly. Add the lentils, crushed tomatoes and broth and let the sauce simmer with a lid for 15-20 minutes. Season with pepper and salt.

Preparing the Béchamel Sauce

Melt the butter in a (small) pot and stir in the flour. While stirring, gradually add the milk. Season with salt and nutmeg and bring to a boil while stirring constantly.

Preparing the Lasagne

Grease the casserole dish with butter. Then layer the lasagne repeatedly with lasagne sheets - béchamel sauce - tomato sauce - cheese. The top layer can end with either Parmesan or mozzarella. When layering, make sure the lasagne sheets are sufficiently covered with liquid to cook in the oven. Bake the lasagne in a preheated oven at about 180°C for about 20 minutes. Test with a fork before removing from the oven to check if the lasagne sheets are cooked through.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Ritter Sport Cake
item.description:
This makes enough for a 24cm springform pan.

Ingredients

  • 2 eggs
  • 1 cup sugar
  • 1/4 cup sunflower oil
  • 1/2 packet baking powder
  • 1 cup flour
  • 1/2 cup mineral water
  • Baking paper
  • 2 containers cream
  • 2 containers sour cream
  • 2 cans mandarins
  • 100g drink powder (typically orange flavor)
  • 1 bar Ritter Sport chocolate (typically a yogurt variety)

Preparing the Base

  1. Beat the eggs, sugar and oil until fluffy in a bowl.
  2. Stir the baking powder, flour and mineral water into the fluffy mixture (the batter is liquid).
  3. Line the bottom of a 24cm springform pan with baking paper and spread the batter evenly on it.
  4. Bake the base at 180°C convection for about 15-20 minutes until golden brown. Test with a fork to see if the base is baked through.

Preparing the Filling

  1. Whip the cream while adding the drink powder, creating a homogeneous mixture.
  2. Spread the sour cream on the cake base and distribute evenly.
  3. Drain the mandarins and distribute evenly on the sour cream.
  4. Spread the whipped cream evenly on the mandarins.
  5. Grate the Ritter Sport chocolate and distribute evenly on the cream.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Roasted Vegetables
item.description:
Ingredients for the Vegetables

  • Waxy potatoes (small ones work well)
  • Carrots
  • Zucchini
  • Bell pepper
  • Shallots
  • Olive oil
  • Salt, pepper, paprika, herbs (e.g. rosemary, thyme, oregano and marjoram)

Ingredients for the Dip

  • 500g Skyr
  • 50ml cream
  • Parsley
  • Chives
  • Lime or lemon
  • Salt and pepper

Preparing the Vegetables

  1. Peel potatoes and carrots, wash zucchini and bell pepper and cut everything into bite-sized pieces.
  2. Peel the shallots as well and halve or quarter depending on size.
  3. Place the vegetables separately by baking time in a bowl with some olive oil and season with salt, pepper, paprika and herbs to taste.
  4. Place the vegetables on a baking tray and bake at 200°C for the times indicated below.

Preparing the Dip

  1. Add Skyr and cream to a bowl and mix well.
  2. Finely chop parsley and chives and stir in.
  3. Season with lime or lemon juice, salt and pepper.

Baking Times

  • Potatoes: 40 minutes
  • Carrots: 30 minutes
  • Zucchini: 15 minutes
  • Bell pepper: 15 minutes
  • Shallots: 15 minutes

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Spaghetti alla Carbonara
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g spaghetti
  • 100g Parmesan
  • 125g ham cubes
  • One egg
  • 500ml milk
  • 2 cloves of garlic
  • Olive oil
  • Vegetable broth

Instructions

  1. Bring a large pot of water with some salt to a boil for the spaghetti.
  2. Peel the garlic cloves and cut into slices.
  3. Heat the olive oil in a large pan/wok and fry the garlic together with the ham.
  4. Add the spaghetti to the boiling water and cook according to package directions.
  5. Add the milk, egg, Parmesan and some vegetable broth to a tall container and blend into a sauce.
  6. Remove the garlic from the pan.
  7. Drain the spaghetti and add to the pan.
  8. Add the sauce to the pan and fold well into the spaghetti. Stir on low to medium heat until the sauce thickens.
  9. Serve the spaghetti directly on plates or in a large bowl.

Enjoy your meal!

PS: Instead of milk, you can use some of the cooking water. If the Parmesan is grated, the sauce doesn’t need to be blended.

item.title: Spinach Lasagne
item.description:
This makes enough for a medium to large casserole dish.

Ingredients

  • 500g spinach
  • 1 onion
  • About 100g butter
  • 30g flour
  • 500ml milk
  • 200g double cream cheese
  • 150g feta cheese
  • Lasagne sheets

Instructions

  1. Grease the casserole dish with butter.
  2. Sauté the finely cubed onion in 50g butter.
  3. Add the spinach to the sautéed onion and season with nutmeg and salt.
  4. Prepare a roux with 50g butter, 30g flour and 500ml milk. Then stir in the cream cheese.
  5. Fold the spinach into the roux.
  6. Layer lasagne sheets and spinach alternately in the casserole dish.
  7. Sprinkle the casserole dish with crumbled feta cheese.
  8. Bake the lasagne at 180-190°C for about 40 minutes.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Spring Salad
item.description:
This makes a medium-sized bowl.

Ingredients

  • 100g lamb’s lettuce
  • 2 oranges
  • 2 shallots
  • 2 tbsp red wine
  • 2 tbsp pine nuts
  • 2 tbsp maple syrup
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • Salt
  • Pepper

Instructions

  1. Wash the lamb’s lettuce and place in a large bowl.
  2. Toast the pine nuts in a pan on low to medium heat until lightly browned.
  3. Peel the shallots and cut into fine cubes.
  4. Peel the oranges, remove white membranes and cut into finger-width pieces.
  5. Mix red wine, maple syrup, olive oil, salt and pepper into a dressing.
  6. Add shallots and oranges to the lamb’s lettuce and fold in the dressing.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Tomato Risotto
item.description:
Large quantity, you may want to halve it.

Ingredients

  • 500g risotto rice
  • 4 onions
  • 1 1/2 cloves of garlic (optional)
  • 4 tbsp olive oil
  • 500g crushed tomatoes
  • 1.5L vegetable broth
  • Salt and pepper
  • Mozzarella (optional)
  • Parmesan (optional)

Instructions

  1. Finely chop garlic and onions and fry in a sufficiently large pot with the olive oil until golden brown.
  2. Add the rice and sauté while stirring until translucent.
  3. Then add the crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and let the risotto cook in a covered pot on low to medium heat.

Optionally fold in the Parmesan and arrange with mozzarella strips.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Trofie alla Genovese
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g pasta
  • 400g beans
  • 400g potatoes
  • 1/2 portion Pesto alla Genovese

Instructions

  1. First, prepare half a portion of Pesto alla Genovese.
  2. Then wash and halve the beans. Peel the potatoes and cut into bite-sized pieces.
  3. Next, cook the potatoes, beans and pasta in a large pot of salted water for 10-14, 10-12, and 10 minutes respectively.
  4. Finally, fold in pesto to taste.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Waffles
item.description:
Ingredients
6

  • 175g butter
  • 175g sugar
  • 1 packet vanilla sugar
  • 4 eggs
  • 1/2 bottle rum flavoring
  • 200g wheat flour (type 405)
  • 50g cornstarch
  • 1/2 packet baking powder

Instructions

  1. Melt the butter and stir in the sugar and vanilla sugar.
  2. Stir in the eggs and rum flavoring.
  3. Mix the flour, cornstarch and baking powder and stir in.
  4. Bake the batter in a waffle iron.

Enjoy your meal!

item.title: Wok Vegetables
item.description:
Ingredients
5

  • One strip of pork tenderloin
  • 4-5 carrots
  • One jar bamboo shoots
  • One jar soybean sprouts
  • One large onion
  • One head of broccoli
  • Peanut oil
  • 350ml chicken broth (or vegetable broth)
  • A handful of peanuts
  • Rice or noodles
  • Seasonings
    • Paprika
    • Curry
    • Soy sauce
    • Sambal oelek
    • Coriander
    • Cumin
    • Five-spice powder

Wok Preparation

  1. Cut the carrots into sticks and sauté together with a chopped onion in peanut oil.
  2. Add the bamboo shoots and soybean sprouts and let simmer in the wok.
  3. Cut broccoli into small florets and add to the wok as well.
  4. Once the broccoli florets have reached the desired firmness, stir in the sauce from the pan and add the peanuts.
  5. Serve with rice or noodles.

Sauce Preparation (additional pan)

  1. Cut pork tenderloin into thin strips and coat in curry and paprika powder.
  2. Fry the pork tenderloin in peanut oil in a pan and then deglaze with soy sauce.
  3. Add the chicken broth and season with sambal oelek, coriander, cumin and five-spice powder.
  4. Finally, thicken the sauce with cornstarch.

Enjoy your meal!
